Verified student deals

ISIC Student Package

Use this page to understand how JVTO handles verified student access on selected private routes. It is a controlled eligibility layer, not a separate tour model.

Eligibility

This is for verified ISIC cardholders, not for unverified discount requests

The student package exists to handle genuine student eligibility in a controlled way, not to weaken the private-route operating model.

Parity

The route quality stays the same

Student pricing should not mean weaker safety, downgraded handling, or a different tour model. The operating standard remains the same private JVTO route.

Booking

Verification happens before the quote is finalized

Guests should present valid ISIC details before assuming student pricing applies to the route they want.

How it works

Student access is an eligibility layer, not a separate operator model

JVTO can apply student pricing to selected private routes for guests who pass ISIC verification. The route logic, support structure, and safety handling remain the same.

  • Submit a valid ISIC number during the inquiry or quote stage.
  • Wait for verification before treating the discounted rate as confirmed.
  • Use the same booking, policy, and route-readiness pages as any other private route.

What stays the same

The route is still private, guided, and safety-led

Student status changes the pricing pathway for eligible routes. It should not reduce safety handling, private transport, or operator accountability.

  • Private-route handling remains the operating default.
  • Route-specific inclusions and health requirements still apply.
  • The same decision-support pages should be read before payment.

Verification flow

How verified student access works

The student route is simple when handled in the right order: verify the card, confirm the route, then continue through the normal JVTO booking flow.

Step 01

Share your ISIC details early

Present the card number during the quote stage so eligibility can be checked before pricing is treated as final.

Step 02

Confirm the eligible route

Student pricing is not assumed to apply to every route family. The team confirms where the scheme applies.

Step 03

Book through the normal JVTO flow

Once verified, the booking still follows the same route, payment, and support logic used across the rest of the site.

External verification

Check the wider ISIC network separately if needed

If you want independent context beyond the JVTO route pages, use the official ISIC network as an external reference. That does not replace the JVTO route, policy, or booking documentation.
